_meta.title: Rayan Accessories — real product intake manifest
_meta.sourceVendor: Yiwu Weiran Jewelry Factory — WeChat Moments export (71 posts)

policy.prices: Source captions carry RMB factory prices. These are INTERNAL ONLY and are never rendered on the site (site policy: quote on request). They live in this file, which is not part of the build output.
policy.specs: Material grade, plating, thickness, dimensions, weight and MOQ are NOT confirmed for real products. They are left unset so the UI states 'confirmed with your quotation' instead of asserting unverified values.
policy.celebrityRefs: Source captions referencing celebrities (posts 25, 53) are stripped from all published copy.
policy.imagesWithText: Images carrying Chinese text, price tags or real people's faces are excluded (see excludedImages).
policy.categoryNaming: Material words in titles appear ONLY where the source caption itself states them (agate/pelican/crystal). Everything else uses visual descriptions (gold-tone, pearl-effect, bead).

_meta.followUp: 17 of the original 25 excluded images were labelled dimension diagrams; the true count is 18. All 18 are now translated and published, and their measured sizes and weights are carried into structured frontmatter. 61.07 needs one client check: the source drawing prints "24.8 cm" where millimetres are clearly intended. Logo and slogan are still outstanding, and the stainless / titanium line has no real material this round.

classificationCorrections.method: Re-audited all 429 source images programmatically: near-white canvas fraction plus a standalone dark caption band at the foot of the frame isolates the factory dimension-diagram template cleanly (18 images at 0.71-0.88 white fraction; the next highest image is 0.48). Every flagged image was then opened at full resolution and read by eye.
classificationCorrections.61.06: Was excluded as a "Chinese dimension-annotation diagram" but is in fact a clean lifestyle photo of hammered silver hoops with no annotation. Restored to the publishable set.
classificationCorrections.57.08: Was NOT excluded and had already been published as a product photo. It is a Chinese dimension diagram. Now translated and republished.
classificationCorrections.61.07: Was NOT excluded and had already been published as a product photo. It is a Chinese dimension diagram. Now translated and republished.
classificationCorrections.consequence: Two Chinese-annotated images had reached the live site. The earlier exclusion list was built from reduced contact sheets, which is exactly how both misses and one false positive slipped through; the new detection pass is exhaustive and cheap to re-run.

translationPolicy.approach: Only the foot-of-frame Chinese weight caption is replaced. The product photo and the dimension lines are left pixel-identical: those annotations already read as bare numerals plus "mm", so no translation was required for them.
translationPolicy.renderedCaption: Pair weight approx. {weightG} g (excl. ear backs)
translationPolicy.structured: The same figures are also written into frontmatter as dimensions_mm and weight_g so the spec table carries them as real text rather than pixels.
translationPolicy.weightBasis: weight_g is a PAIR weight, exactly as the source states (一对). Frontmatter marks weight_basis: pair so the UI can say so.
